entities.name: Query LpxC/FabZ
observations: 440 aa bacterial enzyme sequence; predicted molecular mass 49.1 kDa and theoretical pI 5.77.
Strong homology to reviewed LpxC/FabZ proteins: 37.1–43.0% identity over about 99% of the sequence, with E-values 2.86e-89 to 4.44e-122.
Pfam detects LpxC domain PF03331.20 at residues 5–279 and FabA-like PF07977.20 at residues 307–431; additional ApeP/ApeI-like matches occur in the C-terminal region.
Likely cytosolic enzyme based on homolog localization and absence of sequence evidence for a signal peptide or transmembrane segment.

entities.name: LpxC
observations: UDP-3-O-acyl-N-acetylglucosamine deacetylase; catalyzes the committed deacetylation step in lipid A biosynthesis.
Reference proteins annotate this activity in curated bacterial LpxC/FabZ homologs.

entities.name: FabZ
observations: (3R)-hydroxyacyl-acyl carrier protein dehydratase involved in fatty-acid and lipid A precursor biosynthesis.
Reference proteins annotate dehydration of short-chain and long-chain beta-hydroxyacyl-ACPs.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: LpxC activity is assigned to the committed early step of lipid A biosynthesis; homologs are annotated in the lipid IV(A) pathway.
The pathway contributes to bacterial outer-membrane lipopolysaccharide assembly in organisms that possess lipid A biosynthesis.

entities.name: Fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: FabZ activity supports dehydration of beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP intermediates during fatty-acid biosynthesis, including unsaturated fatty-acid precursor formation.
